svg.text: 1. Budget: SAE J2945/1 fixes the BSM interval at 100 ms; the identity share is f·100 ms with f = 0.5 working assumption (LATENCY_BUDGET §1). P*(f) =

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans Mono, Menlo, Consolas, monospace
DejaVu Sans Mono, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: 2. Measured: SSI warm verify 0.153 ms [0.151, 0.154], cold 0.399 ms, PKI 0.094 ms (#27, N=30, 1,650,318 verifications, 150 failures = 5 injected attacks ×

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans Mono, Menlo, Consolas, monospace
DejaVu Sans Mono, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: 3. Freshness-k sweep (#32): t_eff = 0.428 ms + 10.52 ms / k (full 4-RPC refresh); P*(0.5)=100 at k ≈ 146 (full refresh). One-call probe refresh 2.76 ms, but

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans Mono, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: on the #37 host no finite k reaches P* = 100 (host-dependent knee). Revocation staleness ≤ k − 1 messages (≤ 14.5 s at k = 146, 10 Hz).

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans Mono, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: 4. Excluded: radio / MAC / PHY latency; mobility is simulated. Identity verification is not the V2V bottleneck once the chain is off the hot path (H3).
